name: IntenSelect+
summary: An improved IntenSelect: score-based selection that handles complex object shapes, per-object scoring and faster, more accurate selection.
howItWorks: Like IntenSelect, objects near the pointing ray accumulate a score over time and the highest-scoring one is selected, shown with a bending ray. IntenSelect+ extends the scoring to complex shapes and lets each object have its own scoring parameters.
